newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Adria 10-mo passenger volume up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Adria 10-mo passenger volume up 10 pct.

text.p: Slovenian state-owned Adria Airways' passenger volume rose to 523,400 in the first 10 months of the year, up 10 percent on the same period of 1995, the airline said on Monday.
In October alone, Adria carried 50,400 passengers, a two-percent increase on the same month last year.

The airline's cargo volume in the first 10 months was unchanged at 3,100 tonnes. October cargo traffic was up 13 percent at 378 tonnes, Adria added. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386 61 1263 644
